facts.statement: Fossils of Alopiopsis are found exclusively at Monte Bolca in Italy, dating from 48.6 to 40.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Fossils of Alopiopsis are found only at Monte Bolca (Pesciara) (Eocene of Italy) (age range: from : 48.6 to 40.4 million years ago.).

facts.statement: The genus Alopiopsis was recognized by Paolo Lioy in 1865.
facts.quote: Fue reconocido por Paolo Lioy en 1865.

facts.statement: Fossils of this genus date back to more than 40 million years ago.
facts.quote: Los fósiles de este género datan de hace más de 40 millones de años.

facts.statement: Alopiopsis belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, subclass Elasmobranchii, superorder Selachimorpha, order Carcharhiniformes, and family Carcharhinidae.
facts.quote: regnum: Animalia phylum: Chordata classis: Chondrichthyes subclassis: Elasmobranchii superordo: Selachimorpha ordo: Carcharhiniformes familia: Carcharhinidae genus: Alopiopsis

facts.statement: Alopiopsis plejodon is the recognized species within the genus Alopiopsis.
facts.quote: Especies reconocidas del género: Alopiopsis plejodon Lioy 1865

facts.statement: The genus Alopiopsis lived during the Ypresian stage, from 56 to 48.07 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Ypresian to Ypresian (56 to 48.07 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Alopiopsis is an extinct genus of prehistoric sharks classified within the family Carcharhinidae.
rejected.quote: Alopiopsis is an extinct genus of prehistoric sharks belonging to the family Carcharhinidae.
